card.name: Roles, partners and counterbalances in text
card.fires_on: Words in general web text that set up a role, partner or balancing counterpart, such as role, leg, counter, joint or primary. They sit where the sentence is about to name a complementary or shared function.

modes.label: Role or share
modes.description: Words naming a role or shared position just before the thing filled or taken on.
modes.example: Friedrich Engels in 1895, Kautsky inherited the<< role>> of the intellectual and political conscience of German

modes.label: Third leg of a stool
modes.description: Words inside an image of parts that together make a whole.
modes.example: "Computational chemistry is becoming the third<< leg>> in the stool of chemistry,"

modes.label: Counterbalance or joint
modes.description: Words that start a balancing or paired term.
modes.example: thereby providing the necessary<< counter>>balance to the hegemonic ambitions of China

card.writes: It pushes toward words for partnership, complementarity and dominance, including Chinese words for partner and cooperate.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a role or a partner that balances or completes something else.
